_: Ports example for the forum (docs/plan/forum-2026-10.md): a dredger working on the sand terrace in front of a fringing reef, its overflow plume carried onto the reef by an onshore current, and a vehicle sent across the plume to see what the reef sees. What settles on each colony is judged per day against Erftemeijer et al. (2012).
